source: PARTIAL — see notes. No public dataset publishes the (cohort_year x percentile) matrix in pre-aggregated form. Closest sources: (1) Dune dashboard 'Polymarket Trader Cashflow PnL' by defioasis — https://dune.com/defioasis/polymarket-pnl — aggregate dollar-bin distribution across all cohorts. (2) Academic paper 'Who Wins and Who Loses In Prediction Markets? Evidence from Polymarket' by Akey/Gregoire/Harvie/Martineau (SSRN abstract_id=6443103) — analyzes 1.4M users 2022-2026 with concentration stats but PDF is gated, no cohort-year table publicly visible. (3) Jon Becker's open dataset — https://github.com/jon-becker/prediction-market-analysis (36 GB parquet, every OrderFilled event on Polygon CTFExchange + legacy FPMM trades) — would let us derive the matrix from scratch with several hours of compute.

aggregate_distribution_no_cohort_split.snapshot_source: https://dune.com/defioasis/polymarket-pnl (cashflow PnL = sale proceeds + redemptions - purchase costs, excludes unrealized; covers Polymarket launch through ~May 2026)

academic_aggregate_no_cohort_split.source: Akey, Gregoire, Harvie, Martineau (SSRN 6443103) — 1.4M users, 70M trades, $20B+ volume, Nov 2022 - Oct 2025

what_would_unlock_the_real_matrix.path_a_dune_query: Author a new Dune query joining polymarket.trades with a per-user min(block_time) cohort. Cost: $0 to write, ~$10-50 one-shot exec on Dune's Pro tier (DuneSQL). Wall time: 30-60 min once API key is provisioned. Output: (address, first_trade_year, lifetime_pnl_usd) -> percentile in pandas.
what_would_unlock_the_real_matrix.path_b_jbecker_dataset: Download s3.jbecker.dev/data.tar.zst (36 GB compressed, ~150 GB extracted). Compute per-address cashflow PnL across all OrderFilled events + legacy FPMMBuy/FPMMSell + market resolutions. Bucket by year of first trade. Wall time: 4-12 hours including download.
what_would_unlock_the_real_matrix.path_c_subgraph: Polymarket positions subgraph at Goldsky returns aggregated user positions but not full trade history; pagination over ~2.5M users at 1k/page = 2500 requests, multi-hour and rate-limited.
what_would_unlock_the_real_matrix.path_d_request_paper_authors: Email Akey/Gregoire/Harvie/Martineau and ask for the cohort-year breakdown. They have it. The paper computes it. They just didn't publish that exact crosstab.

warning_for_chart_use: Do NOT fabricate cohort numbers. The Saez/Zucman year-scrub story IS true for Polymarket — every public source confirms profits concentrate over time and later cohorts face a more efficient (read: more brutal) market — but the per-cohort percentile numbers themselves require running one of the four paths above. Shipping fake numbers here would be the one thing the chart's premise cannot survive.
